name: CyTools_AIChat
description: A chat engine for connected agent CLIs, HTTP model APIs and local GGUF models with LoRA adapters. Conversations are kept on disk and opened in tabs in the standalone window.
author: Cyberalien

tested.runtime: Python 3.11.5, cytools-core 0.9.0, imgui-bundle 1.92.900, llama.cpp b11114 CUDA 12.4
tested.status: Launcher, ImGui window in English and French, local GGUF turn on CUDA, GGUF LoRA load and live rescale, Codex app-server and cli-jsonl, Claude Code, Antigravity, Ollama on both of its transports, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, cancellation of a running inference, the update mechanism with fixtures, the CLI, MCP and the pytest suite were executed. OpenCode, the paid HTTP APIs (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic) and a real GitHub release of this application were not.

tested.runtime: Python 3.11.5, cytools-core 0.10.1 (MIT), imgui-bundle 1.92.900, llama.cpp b11114 CUDA 12.4
tested.status: Re-run after the move to CyToolsCore 0.10.1, application 0.1.1: launcher started from another directory with the existing configuration (Chat, Updates and Options tabs, English), the CLI (describe, diagnostics), a real MCP session with two local GGUF turns, GGUF LoRA load and live rescale on CUDA, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, cancellation of a running inference, the update mechanism with fixtures including the licence notices, the release archive build and its verification, and the pytest suite. Not re-run with this SDK version: Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, Ollama and the French window. OpenCode, the paid HTTP APIs and a real GitHub release remain not executed.

tested.runtime: Python 3.11.5, cytools-core 0.10.1; speech: stt torch 2.8.0+cpu transformers 5.18.0, tts torch 2.8.0+cu128 transformers 4.57.3 coqui-tts 0.27.5 f5-tts 1.1.22
tested.status: Application 0.2.0, speech: both speech environments installed by the Tool's operation, the five speech models and the vocoder installed with their digests, transcription with Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (French) and Phonon-2 (English) on the CPU, reading aloud with XTTS-v2 (studio voices and a cloned clip, French and English) and F5-TTS (French and English) on CUDA, checked by transcribing the audio back, the Speech and Chat tabs of the window through the real launcher, and the pytest suite. Not executed: microphone recording and loudspeaker playback with a person speaking and listening, and the voice environment on the CPU.

runtimeRequirements.name: Python
runtimeRequirements.description: The private interpreter in runtime/python runs this Tool.

runtimeRequirements.name: llama.cpp server
runtimeRequirements.description: Needed only by the local provider. Installed from the Tool into runtime/engines; engine_list reports whether it is present.

runtimeRequirements.name: Agent command line
runtimeRequirements.description: codex, claude, agy or opencode, for the agent CLI providers. Each uses its own sign-in; list_providers reports what was found.

distributionStatus: Standalone Windows x64 build validated locally; see app/Docs/CapabilityCoverage.md

operations.name: Chat
operations.description: Send one message and store the reply in a conversation.

conversation.description: Conversation id to continue. Empty starts a new conversation and returns its id.

provider.description: Provider to talk to. Empty reuses the one stored in the conversation.

transport.description: Transport within the provider. Empty uses its default.

model.description: Model identifier for the provider. Empty reuses the conversation model.

system_prompt.description: System prompt for this conversation. A session provider that has no system field receives it folded into the first message, and the reply reports that.

preset.description: Preset id whose system prompt and sampling values fill anything not set explicitly.

engine.description: llama.cpp build for the local provider. auto prefers an installed CUDA build.

threads.description: CPU threads for the local provider. 0 lets llama.cpp decide.

keep_loaded.description: Keep the local model resident after the reply so the next turn starts immediately.

reasoning_effort.description: How much a reasoning model should think before answering. Empty uses the value the catalogue records for that model. "none" turns thinking off through the chat template; the other levels are passed to llama.cpp. Local provider only.

settings.description: Extra provider fields merged into the request, for options this schema does not name.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Higher is more varied. Left unset, the provider default applies.

top_k.description: Keep only the K most likely tokens. Ignored by providers that do not expose it.

repeat_penalty.description: Penalty applied to repeated tokens. Local and Ollama providers only.

seed.description: Sampling seed. -1 leaves it to the provider. The same seed only reproduces a reply with the same weights and runtime.

context_tokens.description: Context window requested when loading a local model. Changing it restarts the local server.

history_limit.description: Send only the last N stored messages to a stateless provider. 0 sends the whole conversation. A session provider keeps its own history and ignores this.

model_profile.description: ID from the local model library; empty uses the selected built-in model.

conversationId.description: Conversation the reply was stored in.

messageId.description: Identifier of the stored assistant message.

kind.description: stateless when the transcript is the context, session when the provider keeps the history.

usage.description: Token accounting as reported by the provider, when it reports any.

nativeSessionId.description: Provider-side session identifier, when the provider has one.

thinkingCharacters.description: Characters of reasoning text streamed but not stored in the reply.

file.description: Markdown file holding the reply inside the job workspace.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the reply file.

outputs.description: Conversation the reply was stored in.
Identifier of the stored assistant message.
stateless when the transcript is the context, session when the provider keeps the history.

operations.name: List providers
operations.description: Inventory every provider with its transports and what was actually detected on this machine.

provider.description: Limit the report to one provider.

operations.name: List provider models
operations.description: Ask a provider for the models it offers. Not every provider publishes a catalogue.

operations.name: List conversations
operations.description: Every stored conversation, most recent first.

operations.name: Read a conversation
operations.description: The full stored transcript of one conversation.

limit.description: Return only the last N messages. 0 returns all of them.

operations.name: Create a conversation
operations.description: Start an empty conversation and return its id.

title.description: Title. Empty derives one from the first message.

operations.name: Delete a conversation
operations.description: Move a conversation out of the active list. The document is kept as a timestamped backup.

operations.name: Export a conversation
operations.description: Write a conversation to a file.

destination.description: Absolute path to write to. Empty writes into data/exports.

operations.name: Forget the provider session
operations.description: Drop the provider-side session so the next turn starts a fresh one. The stored transcript is kept.

provider.description: Limit to one provider. Empty forgets every session of the conversation.

operations.name: List presets
operations.description: Presets shipped with the application and those you saved.

operations.name: Save a preset
operations.description: Create or replace a preset. Secrets are never part of a preset.

settings.description: Sampling values: context_tokens, history_limit, max_tokens, repeat_penalty, seed, temperature, top_k, top_p

operations.name: Delete a preset
operations.description: Remove a preset you saved.

operations.name: List local weights
operations.description: Catalogue of downloadable GGUF models, LoRA adapters and speech models with their installation state.

kind.description: model and lora are chat weights; stt and tts are speech models.

verify.description: Re-hash installed files. Slow on large weights.

operations.name: Install local weights
operations.description: Download and verify a catalogue entry. Resumes an interrupted download.

accept_license.description: Confirms you accepted the licence on the provider page yourself.

baseModel.description: Base model id, for an adapter.

path.description: Installed file path; the folder, for a speech model.

family.description: Engine family of a speech model.

component.description: Installed for another model, not chosen directly.

outputs.description: Base model id, for an adapter.
Installed file path; the folder, for a speech model.
Engine family of a speech model.
Installed for another model, not chosen directly.

operations.name: Repair local weights
operations.description: Re-verify an entry and delete only the files whose digest does not match.

operations.name: Remove local weights
operations.description: Delete the files of a catalogue entry.

libraryReferencesRemoved.description: Model library references dropped with the files.

outputs.description: Model library references dropped with the files.

operations.name: List llama.cpp engines
operations.description: The pinned llama.cpp builds and which one is installed.

operations.name: Install a llama.cpp engine
operations.description: Download, verify and unpack a pinned llama.cpp build into runtime/engines.

operations.name: Remove a llama.cpp engine
operations.description: Delete a build this Tool installed.

operations.name: Speech status
operations.description: The two speech environments, the speech models with their installation state, the running speech workers and the speech settings.

models.description: Speech catalogue rows (kinds stt and tts).

outputs.description: Speech catalogue rows (kinds stt and tts).

operations.name: Install a speech environment
operations.description: Create or repair a private Python environment for speech under runtime/engines: stt (PyTorch CPU and transformers 5, for Phonon-2 and Parakeet) or tts (PyTorch CUDA 12.8 or CPU, XTTS-v2 and F5-TTS). Downloads several gigabytes from PyPI and the PyTorch index. Speech models and voices in data/ are not touched.

device.description: PyTorch build for the tts environment. stt always uses the CPU.

operations.name: Remove a speech environment
operations.description: Delete runtime/engines/stt or runtime/engines/tts. Models and voices stay.

operations.name: Speech settings
operations.description: Read or change the speech preferences. A field left out keeps its value.

stt_model.description: Speech-to-text model id. Empty picks the best installed one.

tts_model.description: Voice model id. Empty picks an installed one that speaks the language.

voice.description: Voice id (voice_list). Empty picks a default for the model.

language.description: auto, or a code such as fr or en.

auto_read.description: Read new replies aloud in the window.

live_dictation.description: Show the words in the window while you speak.

operations.name: Transcribe speech
operations.description: Speech to text with Phonon-2 (English) or Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (25 languages, French included), on the CPU. The model stays loaded for the next request.

audio.description: Audio file: an absolute path anywhere on this machine, or a name inside data/inputs. WAV, FLAC, OGG or MP3. It is copied for the job and the original is left untouched.

model.description: Speech-to-text model id. Empty uses the settings, then the best installed model for the language.

language.description: Expected language, used only to choose the model: en prefers Phonon-2. The models detect the language themselves.

operations.name: Transcribe while recording
operations.description: Follow a recording the desktop window is writing (data/inputs/dictation/live-<id>.pcm, 16-bit mono PCM) and publish DictationPartial events with the text so far, about every half second of new speech. Sentences are closed at pauses and their words become final; the sentence being spoken may still change. The job ends when the window creates <name>.done and returns the whole text. Meant for the window; give a file to transcribe instead.

stream.description: Name of the live recording in data/inputs/dictation.

model.description: Speech-to-text model id. Empty uses the settings.

language.description: Expected language, used only to choose the model.

operations.name: Read text aloud
operations.description: Text to speech with XTTS-v2 or F5-TTS. Give a text, or a conversation and one of its messages to read a stored reply. The audio of a stored reply is kept in data/speech and reused when the same reply is read again with the same voice.

text.description: Text to read. Ignored when conversation and message are given.

conversation.description: Conversation id, to read one of its messages.

model.description: Voice model id. Empty uses the settings.

voice.description: Voice id from voice_list. Empty uses the settings, then a default.

language.description: auto, or a code such as fr or en. Empty uses the settings.

speed.description: Speaking rate. Empty uses the settings.

progressive.description: Publish a SpeechPiece event with a WAV file for each sentence as soon as it is made, so playback can start before the whole text is ready. The pieces are written to data/speech/pieces; whoever plays them deletes them. Cancelling stops after the current sentence.

operations.name: List voices
operations.description: Recorded and imported voices, the sample clips of installed models and the XTTS-v2 studio voices.

items.description: id, name, kind (recorded, sample, studio), language, transcript, clip, families.

operations.name: Add a voice
operations.description: Keep a clip as a voice to imitate. Its words are found by speech to text unless you give them: F5-TTS needs them, XTTS-v2 does not.

audio.description: Audio file: an absolute path anywhere on this machine, or a name inside data/inputs. WAV, FLAC, OGG or MP3. It is copied for the job and the original is left untouched.

name.description: Name shown in the voice list.

language.description: Language spoken in the clip, such as fr or en.

transcript.description: The exact words spoken in the clip.

transcribe.description: Find the words by speech to text when none are given.

voice.description: id, name, kind (recorded, sample, studio), language, transcript, clip, families.

outputs.description: id, name, kind (recorded, sample, studio), language, transcript, clip, families.

operations.name: Delete a voice
operations.description: Move a recorded or imported voice to data/voices/deleted.

operations.name: Unload the speech models
operations.description: Stop both speech workers and free the memory they hold.

operations.name: Local model status
operations.description: Whether a local model is loaded, on which device, with which adapters.

adapters.description: Adapters reported by the running server.

outputs.description: Adapters reported by the running server.

operations.name: Unload the local model
operations.description: Stop the local llama.cpp server and release its reservation.

operations.name: Change adapter strength
operations.description: Set LoRA strengths on the running local server without reloading the model.

loras.description: Strengths in the order the adapters were loaded.

adapters.description: Adapters as the server reports them afterwards.

outputs.description: Adapters as the server reports them afterwards.

operations.name: API key status
operations.description: Whether a key is configured for a provider and how it is protected. Never returns the key.

provider.description: Provider id. Empty reports every provider that can take a key.

operations.name: Remove an API key
operations.description: Delete a stored key.

operations.name: Diagnostics
operations.description: One report covering providers, engines, weights, storage and the resident model.

file.description: Report file in the job workspace.

outputs.description: Report file in the job workspace.

operations.name: Check for updates
operations.description: Ask the configured GitHub sources what the application and the engine could move to.

operations.name: Download an update
operations.description: Stage an update under runtime/updates and verify it there. Nothing is activated.

operations.name: Apply a staged update
operations.description: Activate a verified staged update, keeping the previous version for a rollback. data/ is never replaced.

operations.name: Roll back an update
operations.description: Restore the version kept before the last update.

operations.name: Update sources
operations.description: Read or change the GitHub sources and the automatic check preference.

application_repository.description: owner/name of the application repository. Empty leaves it unchanged.

automatic_check.description: Turn the startup check on or off.

operations.name: model_library_list
operations.description: List compatible model formats, device capabilities and registered local model/LoRA references.
